question: In February 2023, which Indian-American was appointed as the CEO of YouTube?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Neal Mohan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Neal Mohan**, an Indian-American, was appointed as the **CEO of YouTube** in **February 2023**.
 
• He succeeded **Susan Wojcicki**, who stepped down after serving as the CEO for nearly **nine years**.
 
• Neal Mohan has been a key figure at YouTube, having joined the company as its Chief Product
